label: A total holder of another that is MOTION_3 held in the act by which it holds is totally held in it
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred: if f totally holds x in r and f is MOTION_3 held in r (definition ea1904bc-bdfa-4835-a4a7-8545c5221e2e), then f is totally held in r (definition acde39ee-8d60-4ea7-a821-de96c86e5b03). It says that a sole holder is never co-held, nor held only by something it holds back, in the act by which it holds. Substantive objection (target: this bridge; mechanism: co-support; justification: ordinary statics): a beam carried at its two ends by two walls is held in its position by both walls and by neither alone, while it is the only holder of a lamp hung from it that does not prop it; so the beam totally holds the lamp, is held, and is not totally held. That statics establishes the physical holders only; a reading on which the two walls together are one holder would need a mereological bridge that is not formalized. Control part 2 is a finite interpretation in which the bridge fails.
